case_number: 2024 INSC 782; Criminal Appeal No. [unspecified] of 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 9371 of 2018)

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.

summary: FIR quashment under Article 226/Section 482 Cr.P.C.; allegations under IPC s.376 and s.313; investigation completed omitting s.313 charges due to lack of evidence; time gap between alleged offense (2013-2018) and FIR registration (2018) considered; cohabitation as husband-wife acknowledged; deception-based consent claims inconsistent with living arrangement; Bhajan Lal guidelines applied; inherent jurisdiction exercised to quash proceedings where allegations don't disclose cognizable offense or evidence insufficient.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.482, s.155(2), s.156(1)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; FIR quashed; criminal proceedings under s.376 IPC set aside.
